Ask: can you confirm the single committed number for the accounts listed on tab ‘EMEA commit’ and flag any deal that should move to Closed-Won / Not Moving / Needs Legal? A one-line reply per account is ideal (example below).

Example:
- LB-UK-02: Stage = Closed-Won; Committed = $145,000 (signed PO incoming)
- FR-Platform-11: Stage = Negotiation; Committed = $60,000 (discount pending)

We’ll roll the reconciled numbers into tomorrow’s regional rollup to finance and include any follow-ups in the Monday cadence call. If you need someone from our CS/Renewals side looped in, tell me and I’ll add them.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.
